detect.doc: Before Azure AI Foundry, whose `az.ai.` prefix is broader. The legacy system spellings and the current semantic-convention provider value are independently sufficient. OpenInference instead reports the cloud and model API in separate attributes, so that wire shape is a conjunctive alternative below.
detect.label: AzureOpenAI

alternatives.doc: OpenInference 0.1.62 identifies the Azure cloud separately from the OpenAI API. Neither attribute is sufficient alone: Azure also serves non-OpenAI models, and OpenAI may be served directly. Together they identify Azure OpenAI and outrank the shared OpenInference convention.

message_members.doc: "On your data" replies carry their retrieval context in one object: its citations as citations, everything else together.
